title: የመጨረሻው ምዕራፍ (The Final Chapter)
style_block: Cinematic realistic digital painting set in the Ethiopian countryside, warm amber lamp light at night, soft golden morning light, muted earth tones, gentle film grain, natural faces and hands

characters.description: An 18-year-old Habesha young man from the Ethiopian countryside, East African features, deep brown skin, short tightly coiled black hair, slim face, warm dark eyes, simple button-up shirt

A 55-year-old Habesha man from the Ethiopian countryside, East African features, deep brown skin, short greying tightly coiled hair and a short grey beard, kind tired eyes, wearing a white Ethiopian gabi shawl with a thin woven border over a simple shirt

voice.style: calm, warm and serious, like a father speaking softly at night

cues.caption: Gentle acoustic krar and soft ambient pads building from contemplative to hopeful tone, with a subtle radio static burst and sudden silence cut

shots.purpose: Establish the quiet rural countryside atmosphere at night where the journey begins.

keyframe.prompt: Night in a quiet Ethiopian countryside village, unpaved dirt path, nobody outside, a small rural house with plastered earthen walls and a thatched or corrugated iron roof behind a wooden and thorn fence, tall eucalyptus trees and rolling hills in the distance, one small window glowing warm amber, starry dark sky, centred composition

motion.prompt: Slow forward zoom toward the glowing warm window of the countryside house at night.

shots.purpose: Introduce the father and son talking about the weight of the final year in their rural home.

keyframe.prompt: Inside a modest Ethiopian countryside home at night, whitewashed earthen walls, a woven mesob basket and a black clay jebena coffee pot on a rustic shelf, the father standing in the doorway with a woven cloth curtain talking to his 18-year-old son seated at a small rough-hewn wooden table, warm amber lamp light, centred composition

motion.prompt: Slow tilt up from the study table to the father speaking calmly to his seated son.

narration.text: አባቴ እንዲህ አለኝ፦ ፈተና ቀልድ አያውቅም፤ ውጤትም ይቅርታ የለውም።
narration.subtitle: My father told me: an exam knows no jokes, and results know no forgiveness.

shots.purpose: Show the past casual attitude and laughter in a rural school setting before taking focus seriously.

keyframe.prompt: Warm soft memory scene in a rural Ethiopian high school compound, the student laughing with three classmates who are also Habesha Ethiopian teenagers with deep brown skin and tightly coiled black hair, in navy school uniform sweaters, sitting on a wooden bench outdoors, simple single-storey classrooms, eucalyptus trees and green countryside hills behind, a closed textbook beside him, golden backlight, centred composition

motion.prompt: Gentle pan across the seated figures in warm outdoor countryside light.

narration.subtitle: Back then, I did not understand.

shots.purpose: Artistic radio cut as the student begins studying—a vintage radio clicks off into quiet focus without explaining everything literally.

keyframe.prompt: Artistic still life close-up at night on a rustic wooden table in an Ethiopian countryside home, a vintage portable radio with a glowing dial next to an open notebook and a small kerosene lamp, shadow play across earthen wall, poetic moody atmosphere, centred composition

motion.prompt: Slow subtle push-in as the radio dial light dims and falls into quiet stillness while shadows lengthen.

narration.subtitle: When the sound cut off, focus began.

shots.purpose: Show the student starting serious late-night study right after the radio cut.

keyframe.prompt: The student leaning over a small rustic wooden table at night in a modest Ethiopian countryside home, reading by a small kerosene lamp with a quiet unlit radio nearby, whitewashed earthen wall and a clay jebena on a shelf softly blurred behind, serious focused expression, centred composition

motion.prompt: Slow push-in on the seated person turning a book page under warm light.

narration.subtitle: But his words never let me go.

shots.purpose: Symbolize sustained dedication and passing nights through notes and a worn pencil.

keyframe.prompt: Close-up of the same rustic wooden table at night, a short worn pencil stub beside notebook pages filled with handwriting too small to read, a small kerosene lamp glowing, centred composition

motion.prompt: Slow downward camera pan focusing on the table surface and short pencil.

shots.purpose: Show calm readiness on exam or final-year morning walking through the countryside.

keyframe.prompt: Early morning on a quiet dirt path in the Ethiopian countryside leading toward a rural secondary school exam centre, low classroom blocks with corrugated iron roofs, eucalyptus groves, pastures, and distant hills, the student walking calmly holding a small pencil case, empty hands otherwise, other students far away and out of focus, soft golden sunrise light, centred composition

motion.prompt: Slow camera tracking shot following the walking figure along the rural path toward the distant school.

shots.purpose: Deliver the father's reflective closing word on the final chapter outside their rural home.

keyframe.prompt: Daylight in the yard of a small countryside home in Ethiopia with a wooden fence, an older man in a white gabi and a tall young man of about 20 with a light moustache, the young man slightly taller than the older man, standing side by side and smiling, the older man's hand proudly on the young man's shoulder, eucalyptus trees, fields, and distant hills behind, centred composition

motion.prompt: Slow push-in toward the father and son standing together near the doorway in daylight.

narration.text: ያን ቀን አባቴ ፈገግ ብሎ አለኝ፦ የመጨረሻው ምዕራፍ ቀልድ አይወድም።
narration.subtitle: That day my father smiled and said: the final chapter does not like jokes.

shots.purpose: Close with a quiet invitation to start tonight.

keyframe.prompt: Still life close-up, no people, empty rural room: an open notebook on the small rustic wooden table at night, a small kerosene lamp glowing beside it, a white woven cloth with a colourful border on the table edge, dark softly blurred background, centred composition

motion.prompt: Slow zoom-out from the illuminated open book on the dark rustic wooden table.
